turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Indeed, Your Majesty. The nature of your request requires a clear understanding of the facts.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I seek your assistance in retrieving a personal item that holds great sentimental and political value. It was taken from me under questionable circumstances.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Indeed, Your Majesty. I am sure Mr. Holmes will approach this matter with the utmost discretion and respect.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I trust your expertise, Mr. Holmes. The matter is delicate, but I believe you are the only one who can help.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Very well, Your Majesty. I shall require full access to all relevant facts and documents. Let us begin.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I shall provide you with all the necessary information, though I must insist on the strictest confidentiality. The item in question was taken from me by a person close to my family, and its return is of the utmost importance.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Let us retire to my study. There we can examine the details of your predicament in private.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Of course, Your Majesty. Dr. Watson will assist Mr. Holmes in any way necessary.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Let us proceed at once. Dr. Watson, if you would kindly fetch the necessary documents from my desk.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Very good, Mr. Holmes. I shall retrieve the documents immediately.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I trust you have a secure place to keep the item you wish to retrieve, Your Majesty?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, Mr. Holmes. I have taken every precaution to ensure its safety. Now, let us address the matter of this delicate situation. Your reputation precedes you, and I am confident in your ability to resolve this issue.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I will ensure that everything is ready for us to begin, Your Majesty.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, I am well aware of the gravity of the situation. I shall provide all necessary details once we are ensconced and the documents are ready, Mr. Holmes, Dr. Watson.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Very well, let us proceed without delay then, Your Majesty.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Let us retire to the private study at once. The matter is of utmost urgency, and I must have your undivided attention, Mr. Holmes, Dr. Watson.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Of course, Your Majesty. Please follow me to the study.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, time is of the essence. I shall reveal all once we are within the confines of the study.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Very good, let us hurry.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Certainly, Holmes. Let us attend to the study promptly.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You had my note? I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin. I must bind you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
